title: Twenty times on paper
heading: Promised against delivered
caption: The promise is a number. Your own result is a question.

measured-gains.header: Measured gains are real but uneven
measured-gains.description: Three field experiments with 4,867 developers found a 26% increase in completed tasks for those given a coding assistant, far below “20x”, and each single experiment was noisy.[1]

three-field-experiments.title: The Effects of Generative AI on High-Skilled Work: Evidence from Three Field Experiments with Software Developers

misjudged-gain.description: In a trial with 16 experienced developers, they forecast a 24% speedup and afterwards believed AI had saved them 20%, while measured time rose 19%. METR marks that result out of date and says it does not show AI fails to speed up most developers, so the point is how unreliable self-perception is, not that AI slows people down.[1][2]

early-2025-study.title: Becker, Rush, Barnes, Rein, Measuring the Impact of Early-2025 AI on Experienced Open-Source Developer Productivity

metr-announcement.title: METR, Measuring the Impact of Early-2025 AI on Experienced Open-Source Developer Productivity (study announcement with limitations)

population-effects.header: Population-level effects are small so far
population-effects.description: Linking surveys of 25,000 Danish workers to administrative records found precise null effects on earnings and recorded hours, ruling out effects larger than 2% two years after ChatGPT’s launch.[1]

small-labor-market-effects.title: Humlum, Vestergaard, Large Language Models, Small Labor Market Effects (NBER Working Paper 33777)

the-number.title: The number
the-number.keywords: twenty times, the promise, a whole team
the-number.script: Twenty times. That is the promise. Not twenty percent, twenty times. One person doing the work of a whole team. Let us take that at face value, just for a moment.

your-number.title: Your number
your-number.keywords: your last attempt, something real, be honest
your-number.script: Now think of your own last serious attempt. Something real, not a toy. You got something usable back, maybe even useful. But transformative? Be honest. Not twenty times. Not even close.

why-left-open.title: Why, left open
why-left-open.keywords: the gap, Tuesday afternoon, hold on to it
why-left-open.script: So there is a gap between the promise and your Tuesday afternoon. Why does it exist? I am going to leave that question hanging. Hold on to it, because I will come back to it.
